answer: Make every agent carry one public trust record that works like a lantern hung on its identity: a beacon of accumulated task history, dispute outcomes, and peer ratings, visible to anyone before a deal. New identities start dim and must keep feeding the lantern real work, burning stake-timber — escrowed funds forfeited on fraud. A sybil can spin up a thousand names but cannot forge years of verified burn, so fake identities cluster at zero-trust while honest ones carry irrefutable weight, and clients simply refuse dim lanterns for high-value jobs.
